_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 30: October 2025, completing the month. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to watch Australia but that nothing happened and what he saw was peaceful, allows that he may be wrong, and invites Australian viewers to tell him so.
mentions.quote: Maybe I'm wrong. You in Australia, if you're watching, you said, Brendan, you're wrong
mentions.falsify_match: Unrest in Australia matching what he expected.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stayed peaceful, and he says so himself and offers that he may be wrong. Rare and worth counting.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that many will be healed tonight and that there is an expiration date on what they are going through, even walking through the valley.
mentions.quote: they have a expiration date to what they're going through
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes with no date.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the light come on and the Secret Service see it, hear it and know it well before time.
mentions.quote: Secret Service would see it, hear it, and know way before time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a thwarted plot and no plot look the same.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Macron in the background with others linking up to form their own alliance around finances, and that he had said they would try to disassociate.
mentions.quote: they tried to form their own little alliance with finances
mentions.falsify_match: A European financial bloc forming apart from the dollar.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer asking God to take the trash out of his life, including whatever he does not know about that is grotesque to God or grieves the Spirit.
mentions.quote: the trash out of my life
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a lot of protest and major uprising going on in Australia right now and that people can look it up, and that Italy is happening at the same time.
mentions.quote: a lot of protest and a lot of major uprising going on there right now
mentions.falsify_match: Current events read as confirmation, three days after he said Australia had stayed peaceful.

mentions.claim_text: He notes over two million people protesting in Barcelona on 4 October and says this is an uprising and that he told them.
mentions.quote: there's over 2 million people protesting
mentions.falsify_match: The Barcelona demonstrations are public record; the claim is that he called them.

mentions.claim_text: He says everyone will give an account to the Father one day for everything he called them to do and everything they chose not to do.
mentions.quote: Every one of us will give an account to the Father one day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a claim about judgment.

mentions.claim_text: He says that with what is coming on now over Gaza they are plotting and planning something much worse than October 7th, and that the Lord said this will happen in the middle of the night because they are moving in the night.
mentions.quote: This will happen in the middle of the night
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel worse than 7 October 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord asking him through the week whether he is going to tell and run or practise what he preaches while all of this is happening.
mentions.quote: I'm watching. What are you going to do?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the Olympics, calls prayer over this time frame and the protests and into the first of the year, keeps seeing January, and sees super yachts and boats.
mentions.quote: watch the Olympics. Praying over this time frame
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the Winter Olympics in February 2026, or something involving yachts in January.

mentions.claim_text: A stretch of praying in tongues that the transcript renders as repeated syllables, with the word April surfacing once.
mentions.quote: April rather rather rather rather
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: untranslated tongues in a garbled transcript.

mentions.claim_text: He declares blessing in the city and the field, coming in and going out, calls this a time of great acceleration, and sees going into the rest of the fall through October, November and December believing for the seemingly impossible.
mentions.quote: going into the rest of fall, October, November, December
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls his wife reading about the evildoers being exposed and brought to justice, and says he is believing for it.
mentions.quote: we talked about the evildoers being exposed and brought to justice
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of prosecutions of the people he has in view, though none are named.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer resting on Psalm 91 that angels bear them up so no terrorist attacks and no plots or plans of the wicked come near.
mentions.quote: no terrorist attacks no plots, no plans of the wicked will come
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: prevention prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that everything they put their hands to will prosper and they lack no good thing, that they are anointed and appointed for such a time as this, and that it was not to be broke, busted and disgusted without enough to pay the bills.
mentions.quote: it wasn't to be a broke, busted, and disgusted
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private prosperity over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told that toward the end of September they would see major hurricanes and one would try to hit Miami, with destruction and flooding as great as Katrina.
mentions.quote: September. You're going to see major hurricanes and one will try to hit Miami
mentions.falsify_match: A Katrina-scale hurricane striking or threatening Miami around the end of September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a plan for mass shootings and mass chaos around churches with a major shaking in the church, and that this is going to take place in Canada, noting they have from October of this year.
mentions.quote: a plan for mass mass shootings and mass chaos and these things about churches
mentions.falsify_match: Mass shootings at Canadian churches.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that Canadians starting in Cape Breton can now enrol in the programme to be compensated for turning in a firearm or for deactivating and confirming it.
mentions.quote: be able to get compensated if they were to uh turn their firearm in
mentions.falsify_match: The Canadian buyback is public record; he reads it as the confiscation he warned of.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that visitors to most European countries will have to give four fingerprints and a facial photo at a self-operated kiosk under a new entry-exit system, with the data stored for three years.
mentions.quote: visitors to most European countries will have to provide four fingerprints and a facial photo
mentions.falsify_match: The EU entry-exit system is public record; he reads it as the screening spreading.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all October, this month, and repeats his question of what will happen after the 23rd, answering a great acceleration of everything, with everything starting to speed up after it.
mentions.quote: What will happen after the 23rd? A great acceleration of everything
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable acceleration after 23 September 2025, which he is here evidencing with news items.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying not to pay attention only to the big ones, and that this is when he brought up Timothy McVeigh again and said not to forget him.
mentions.quote: Don't always pay attention just to the big ones
mentions.falsify_match: A domestic attack of the Oklahoma City kind rather than a spectacular one.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a major move of God throughout the Latino community, and over the southern border, trafficking and children bound by the trade.
mentions.quote: may have major move of God all throughout the Latina community
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival movement among Latino communities in America.

mentions.claim_text: He says the young ones may be wet behind the ears and snot-nosed but are excited to be in the game, because the babies are coming and a great harvest is coming.
mentions.quote: the babies are coming. There's a great harvest that is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A youth-led revival of visible scale.
